Marka House — A branding and digital marketing platform

Brand identity and service portfolio combined in one showcase.

2026
Scope

01 / Overview

Marka House is a branding and marketing agency. This project is a fast, interactive web platform that serves as the agency’s digital identity: it presents the brand’s visual story, makes the service portfolio easy to browse and guides prospective clients to the right services.

02 / The problem

The agency’s site had to prove its design skill and explain its services clearly at the same time. Often one goal undermines the other: sites end up either beautiful but hard to understand, or clear but forgettable.

03 / Our approach

The visual story and the service structure were separated into distinct layers. A gallery showcases the brand’s work, while service blocks explain the offering through a clear hierarchy. Animations run through client-side routing so they do not burden the server.

04 / The result

Visitors see the agency’s work and understand how to buy each service. Briefs and enquiry forms feed straight into the API.

05 / Key features

What it does.

  • 01

    Dedicated galleries for brand creation, design and marketing projects.

  • 02

    Smooth on mobile, tablet and desktop.

  • 03

    Secure forms for service enquiries and briefs.

  • 04

    SEO and speed

    Near-instant page loads and stronger search ranking through Next.js SSR.

06 / Architecture

How it is built.

  1. Performance-focused frontend

    Modern web animations run smoothly through client-side routing.

  2. Extensible infrastructure

    A clean .NET Core API makes it easy to add a new service module, a client panel or a CRM later.
